subject: heater shield standing upright on its point, its painted face toward the viewer: a flat-topped shield with gently curved sides meeting in a point at the bottom, a little taller than it is wide, its face slightly curved back toward its sides; boards of wood covered in leather, painted in two faded colours, dull red above and ochre below, divided by a straight line across, the paint chipped and worn back to brown leather in places, scratched and dented; a rim of dark rawhide stitched round its edge; no boss; a well-used warrior's shield, plain, not ornate, no emblem
